subject.title: fix(worker): redact shared egress connection detail

question: Must the redacted Worker response be coordinated with the pointer-aware CLI release, or may older CLIs temporarily report false disconnections for use-share callers?
rationale: The security contract is already supported by the linked issue review, but the independently deployed Worker and CLI create a real mixed-version behavior choice that code review cannot resolve without release intent.

options.title: Coordinate Worker and CLI rollout
options.body: Make the compatible CLI available before or with the Worker and document the minimum client version for coarse shared status.

options.title: Version the response contract
options.body: Add a compatibility mechanism that prevents older clients from interpreting redacted fields as real disconnections.

options.title: Accept temporary degradation
options.body: Deploy immediately and explicitly accept misleading old-CLI status output for use-share callers.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Worker and CLI rollout
recommendation.body: Make the compatible CLI available before or with the Worker and document the minimum client version for coarse shared status.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history across the egress protocol, CLI consumer, Worker deployment, and release path.
